metadata.title: Type I estimates for the Kahler-Ricci flow I
metadata.abstract: We establish the Type I estimate for the scalar curvature of the Kahler-Ricci flow on compact Kahler manifolds, for arbitrary smooth initial metrics, whenever the flow develops finite time singularities. This estimate is a building block for the analytic minimal model program with Ricci flow.
